freeze_chain_enforcement.state_on_main: INTACT - 7 of 7 recorded files match when each is resolved through the newest recorded amendment (2 via the D19/D20 amendment S1, 5 via prior_manifest as untouched); zero unrecorded drift
freeze_chain_enforcement.finding: ZERO of the 53 workflows in .github/workflows references the hsg lane, the freeze builder or the exact suite. The freeze chain is DISCIPLINE-ENFORCED, NOT GATE-ENFORCED.
freeze_chain_enforcement.why_it_matters: A frozen artifact can come to assert something false with nothing to catch it. Live instance: FREEZE_D19_D20_V1.json records prior_manifest_sha256_observed for EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY_V1.json and HOSTILE_REGISTRY_V1.json plus prior_unamended_files_still_match_v1_0=true; the pending D21/D22 amendment V1.2 modifies both files, which would falsify that assertion silently. The owning lane was asked to record the supersession from its own side before merging, rather than editing another lane's landed freeze artifact.
freeze_chain_enforcement.verification_method_caveat: Comparing the TOP-LEVEL manifest_sha256 against the live tree reports FALSE drift on any file carrying a legitimate recorded amendment. Resolve each file through the newest amendment naming it, fall back to the original manifest, and assert separately that unamended files still match. This false positive was hit and fixed once by the D19/D20 lane's own builder and once by an ad-hoc check here - recorded because the checker was wrong before it was right.
freeze_chain_enforcement.disposition: OPEN defect, recorded rather than silently dropped: an integrity mechanism with no enforcement gate. Candidate D4 hostile family - 'a freeze assertion becomes false and no gate notices'.

absent_atom_class_gap.observation: G and E are null for ALL 78 atoms in READINESS_MATRIX_V1. Under the frozen scoring policy (non-load-bearing = null, never blocks) that is not an unmeasured gap -- it is a consequence of class membership.
absent_atom_class_gap.root_cause: DEVELOPMENTAL_LINEAGE / EMPIRICALLY_SUPPORTED_AT_SCOPE is the ONLY closure profile in READINESS_SCHEMA_V1 that requires G (>=3) or E (>=3), and ATOM_REGISTRY_V1 contains ZERO atoms of that class. Class census: THEOREM 38, EMPIRICAL_REGULARITY 18, GOVERNANCE_META 10, ENGINEERING_MECHANISM 9, SELF_EVOLUTION 3, DEVELOPMENTAL_LINEAGE 0.
absent_atom_class_gap.why_it_is_critical: DEVELOPMENTAL_LINEAGE is the class of the programme's own central claim -- one persistent OCM becoming progressively better at creating its own future cognition, recorded as an externally supplied optimization target in EXTERNAL_COGNITIVE_INPUT_LEDGER entry ECI-0003. That claim currently has NO REGISTERED ATOM. It is not scored, not gated and not blocked; it is absent.
absent_atom_class_gap.structural_lesson: An absent atom is invisible to every downstream instrument. D2 scores atoms that exist; D3's blocker DAG is seeded from gap_vs_closure_profile, which computes gaps for atoms that exist. A claim with no atom therefore produces no gap, no blocker and no critical-path entry. The closure machinery can only be as complete as its enumeration, and nothing in the machinery detects its own under-enumeration.
absent_atom_class_gap.disposition: OPEN GAP, recorded rather than silently carried. Two things follow. (1) D1 needs a completeness pass specifically for DEVELOPMENTAL_LINEAGE and for any other class with zero members, asking what claim the programme makes that the class was created to hold. (2) Registering such an atom will make G, E, C>=4, A>=4 and R>=4 load-bearing for the first time, which is a materially harder profile than anything currently scored -- so the registry's apparent health partly reflects which claims were enumerated.
absent_atom_class_gap.relation_to_ebf0: Issue #296 EB-F0 is the machinery for exactly this class: sec 9's frozen continued-vs-reset evidence bridge with an inherited-object knockout is the C evidence, sec 5's coarse-graining across ecologies is G, the ecological worlds are E, and sec 3's protected-assay noninterference is A. EB-F0 does not by itself close the registry gap; the atom still has to be enumerated and bound.
absent_atom_class_gap.not_a_defect_in_D2_or_D3: Both artifacts are correct given their inputs. This is an enumeration gap upstream of them, which is why it is recorded here in the coverage map rather than as a correction to either.
